snippet.title: Ourself – Official Trailer | 2 Players, 1 Body | Co-op Physics Game on Steam
snippet.description:
Two players. One body. No chance of agreeing. 👉 Wishlist Ourself on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5279120/Ourself/

You get the left half of the body. Your friend gets the right. Now every obstacle takes the two of you in perfect sync — head in different directions and you both fall.

Ourself is an online co-op physics platformer for two people sharing one character. An evil sorcerer pulled one friend's soul out and put it inside the other, and the body has listened to you both ever since.

🎮 What that turns into:
• One arm and one leg each — and you are going to need them
• Height that punishes you both at once
• A fishing rod you will be using for anything but fishing
• Mine carts, a flying pirate ship, cranes, cannons and levers
• Several themed zones and secret stretches

👥 Online co-op for two: a friend from your Steam list, or an open room with a stranger.

📅 Planned release: October 29, 2026. The game will keep getting updates after launch.
❤️ Wishlist on Steam — Steam emails you on release day: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5279120/Ourself/
💬 Need a second player? Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/dNVvzuTdwx

Music: "The Great Jelly Loop", Ourself's main menu theme.
Developed and published by BOGITY LLC.

#Ourself #CoopGame #IndieGame
